args.name: path
args.doc: A page: /, /shop, /shop/<dept>, /shop/<dept>/<type>, /p/<product id>, /compare?ids=a,b, /wishlist, /bag, /checkout, /orders, /returns, /gifts, /about. Not /kiosk.

moves.doc: Go to a page of the store, ringing the link, card or icon that leads there first.

args.name: dept
args.doc: The department: the gender scope (men and women include unisex; boys and girls are kids; all: every product).

args.name: types
args.doc: Article type ids from the catalogue (kurtas, heels, watches).

args.name: colours
args.doc: Catalogue colour names (Navy Blue, Maroon).

args.name: sizes
args.doc: Size labels: M, XL, 32, UK 7. A product matches when one of them is in stock.

args.name: price_min
args.doc: Rupees, the selling price.

args.name: price_max
args.doc: Rupees, the selling price.

args.name: discount_min
args.doc: At least this percent off MRP.

args.name: usage
args.doc: Occasion: Casual, Ethnic, Formal, Sports, Party, Smart Casual, Travel.

args.name: seasons
args.doc: Summer, Fall, Winter, Spring.

args.name: query
args.doc: Words the product name must contain (silk, floral, chanderi).

moves.doc: Set the listing's whole search (absent fields are cleared). On /shop each filter control that changes is ringed and set in turn, then the grid follows. Navigates to /shop first when elsewhere.

args.name: product_id
args.doc: A product id on screen, 7421.

moves.say: {show: 7421} at the start of the sentence about one product on screen: its card is ringed.
moves.doc: Ring one product's card (listing, compare, wishlist, gifts or kiosk results), scrolling it into view. Changes nothing.

args.name: ids
args.doc: Two to four product ids.

moves.doc: Open /compare with these products side by side; the rows are ringed in turn.

args.name: size
args.doc: A size label of the product: M, 32, UK 7, Onesize.

moves.doc: On the product page: ring the size selector and select the size. Refused when the product has no such size; an out-of-stock size is refused with the sizes in stock.

args.name: size
args.doc: The row to ring.

moves.doc: Open the product's size chart drawer (right) and ring the row of the size, if given.

args.name: usual_size
args.doc: The size they usually wear: S, M, 32, UK 7.

moves.doc: On the product page's Find my size panel: open it and fill what the shopper said, each field ringed. Recommends nothing by itself.

args.name: size
args.doc: The recommended size, in stock.

args.name: reason
args.doc: One short sentence: why this size.

args.name: wanted
args.doc: The size the rule chose when it is out of stock (the card says so).

moves.doc: Show the fit pick on the Find my size panel (the size, the reason, and the out-of-stock size it replaces) and select the size.
Ring the product's heart and add it to (or take it off) the wishlist.
Ring Add to bag and add the product in that size (the bag count pulses). Refused for a size not in stock.

args.name: note
args.doc: The gift note as the shopper dictated it, up to 150 characters.

moves.doc: On the bag: ring the line's Gift wrap toggle and set it (₹49 an item), and fill its note. Navigates to /bag first.
On /checkout: ring a section the shopper fills themselves (name and phone, address, payment) or the Place order button. Fills nothing: personal details are typed by the shopper.

args.name: recipient
args.doc: Her, Him, Mom, Dad, Sister, Brother, Friend, Partner, Kid.

args.name: budget_max
args.doc: Rupees; 0 for no limit.

args.name: size
args.doc: Their size, if clothes or shoes are welcome.

args.name: patterns
args.doc: Solid, Printed, Striped, Checked, Embroidered.

args.name: material
args.doc: Cotton, Silk, Leather, Steel.

moves.doc: On /gifts: fill the gift brief as the shopper says it (absent fields are left as they are), each field ringed. Shows nothing by itself.

args.name: ids
args.doc: Three to six product ids.

args.name: reasons
args.doc: One short reason per product, same order.

moves.doc: On /gifts: show the gift shortlist, each card with its reason, ringed one by one.
On /orders: select the order and open its tracking and items, ringed.
Open the cancel dialog for an order that is not yet dispatched (Placed or Packed), ringing its Cancel order button. Cancels nothing: the shopper presses it. Refused once shipped.

args.name: product_id
args.doc: The item to return.

args.name: unused
args.doc: The shopper said it is unused (only after they said so).

args.name: tags
args.doc: The shopper said the tags are intact (only after they said so).

moves.doc: On /returns: open the order's return form and fill what was said, each field ringed. Submits nothing: the shopper presses Submit return. Refused when the order is outside the 7-day window or not delivered.
On the kiosk: search the whole catalogue and show the results grid (absent fields are cleared).
On the kiosk: open one product full screen with its sizes, price and the QR code to its page.

args.name: product_id
args.doc: Absent: the shortlist's QR code.

moves.doc: On the kiosk: show the big QR code that opens the product page (or the shortlist) on the shopper's phone.
On the kiosk: add the product to (or take it off) the kiosk shortlist.
On the kiosk: call a floor assistant (a banner says one is on the way).

slices.doc: the page in front of the shopper
the product page: the size picked and the Find my size panel
the checkout form: only whether each section is filled, never what the shopper typed
the gift finder's brief and shortlist
the kiosk: its search, the product open and the shortlist

events.note: {by} filled Find my size for {product_id}: height {height_cm}, usual size {usual_size}, fit {fit}
{by} filled the checkout: contact {contact}, address {address}, payment {payment}; the details themselves stay on the page

events.ask: they placed the order themselves: thank them by first name in one line, say the order number and when it arrives
they cancelled the order themselves: confirm it in one line and say how the refund comes back

events.note: {by} changed the return for {order_id}: item {product_id}, reason {reason}, unused {unused}, tags {tags}

events.ask: they submitted the return themselves: confirm it in one line with the pickup and refund timing
